:::{#rem-surprisal-units}
#### Rarer values are more surprising, and the logarithm base sets the unit

A possible value $x$ with [probability](probability-basics.qmd#def-probability) $\P(X=x) = 1$ has [surprisal](#def-surprisal) $0$,
and the surprisal grows without bound as $\P(X=x) \to 0$.
The base of the logarithm determines the unit:
nats for the natural logarithm and bits for base 2.

:::
